description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat
